select from kg_kindergarten_staff left join sys_user on kg_kindergarten_staff.uid = sys_user.user_id where kg_kindergarten_staff.del_flag = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT sri.role_names, staff.id, staff.staff_number, staff.NAME, staff.phone, staff.education, staff.staff_number, staff.hiredate, staff.sex, staff.education, staff.quit_date FROM kg_kindergarten_staff staff LEFT JOIN ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( sr.role_name ) role_names, sur.user_id, sr.STATUS FROM sys_user_role sur LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON sur.role_id = sr.role_id WHERE sur.user_type = 2 AND sr.STATUS = '0' GROUP BY sur.user_id ) sri ON staff.uid = sri.user_id WHERE staff.del_flag = 0 AND staff.identity = 1 AND staff.kg_id = #{queryVO.kgId}
AND `name` LIKE concat('%', #{queryVO.name}, '%')
AND `phone` LIKE concat('%', #{queryVO.phone}, '%')
AND `is_quit` = #{queryVO.queryType.code} ORDER BY staff.create_time DESC

SELECT sri.role_names, sri.role_ids, kbsk.id, staff.staff_number, staff.NAME, staff.phone, staff.education, staff.staff_number, staff.hiredate, staff.sex, staff.education, staff.quit_date FROM kg_bloc_staff staff LEFT JOIN kg_bloc_staff_kindergarten kbsk ON staff.id = kbsk.bloc_staff_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( sr.role_name ) role_names, Group_CONCAT( sr.role_id ) role_ids, sur.user_id FROM sys_user_role sur LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON sur.role_id = sr.role_id WHERE sur.user_type = 1 AND sr.STATUS = '0' GROUP BY sur.user_id ) sri ON kbsk.id = sri.user_id WHERE kbsk.kindergarten_id = #{queryVO.kgId} AND staff.identity = 1 AND kbsk.del_flag = 0
AND `name` LIKE concat('%', #{queryVO.name}, '%')
AND `phone` LIKE concat('%', #{queryVO.phone}, '%')
ORDER BY kbsk.create_time DESC

SELECT
IFNULL(staff.NAME,'') '姓名',
CASE staff.sex WHEN 0 THEN '男' WHEN 1 THEN '女' ELSE '未知' END '性别',
IFNULL(staff.phone,'') '手机号码',
IFNULL(sri.role_names,'') '岗位',
IFNULL(staff.staff_number,'') '员工号码',
IFNULL(staff.marriage,'') '婚姻状况',
IFNULL(staff.school,'') '毕业院校',
IFNULL(staff.nation,'') '民族',
IFNULL(staff.address,'') '现居住地址',
IFNULL(staff.identity_number,'') '身份证号码',
IFNULL(staff.hiredate,'') '入职日期',
IFNULL(staff.education,'') '学历',
IFNULL(staff.major,'') '专业',
IFNULL(staff.account_address,'') '户口所在地'
FROM kg_kindergarten_staff staff LEFT JOIN ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( sr.role_name ) role_names, sur.user_id, sr.STATUS FROM sys_user_role sur LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON sur.role_id = sr.role_id WHERE sur.user_type = 2 AND sr.STATUS = '0' GROUP BY sur.user_id ) sri ON staff.uid = sri.user_id WHERE staff.del_flag = 0 AND staff.identity = 1 AND staff.kg_id = #{exportVO.kgId} AND `is_quit` = 0
AND staff.`name` LIKE concat('%', #{exportVO.queryName}, '%')
AND staff.`phone` LIKE concat('%', #{exportVO.queryPhone}, '%')
ORDER BY staff.create_time DESC

SELECT id, `NAME`, phone FROM kg_kindergarten_staff WHERE kg_id = #{queryVO.kgId} AND id NOT IN ( SELECT temp.teacher_id FROM ( SELECT teacher_id FROM kg_classroom WHERE kg_id = #{queryVO.kgId} AND del_flag = false UNION SELECT sub_teacher_id FROM kg_classroom WHERE kg_id = #{queryVO.kgId} AND del_flag = false ) temp WHERE temp.teacher_id IS NOT NULL )
AND `name` like concat('%', #{queryVO.name}, '%')
AND is_quit = false ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id,kks.name FROM kg_kindergarten_staff kks join sys_user_role sur on kks.uid = sur.user_id join sys_role sr on sr.role_id = sur.role_id where kks.kg_id = #{kgId} and kks.del_flag = 0 and kks.is_quit = 0 and sr.role_name = '教师' and sr.role_type = 2 and sr.association_id = #{kgId}
